summary: Every answer is a country a casual player knows, with a few news-driven surprises (Germany at #4, Ukraine at #7). Easy, but the near misses (Israel #11, South Korea #13) teach something. Strong for Blitz too.
reasons: Casual player cleared 10/10 losing 3 lives: Israel (#11) and Iran (#38) are fair, informative misses; North Korea costs a life with no rank because it has no data.
Curve leans easy: US, China, Russia, UK, France, India are gimmes, and Germany, Saudi Arabia, Ukraine and Japan only need a moment of thought.
Deep Blitz pool: 40 countries carry a stat, a casual 90 s run scored 22 of 24.
fixes: Remove junk aliases: 'Project Meridian', 'United States military ranks', 'US military branches' (United States); 'Customs and etiquette in the services' (India); 'Prince Pickles' (Japan); 'Russian Foreign Legion', 'Muscovian army' (Russia); 'Swedish sin' (Sweden).
Drop 'Zhongguo' from Taiwan (#22); it is the name of China and only adds a choice prompt.
